summary: Retested vehicle print/PDF flows on preview. Header print menu regression appears fixed (single menu button, overlay visible, invoice/diagnosis/quote previews all open and resolve with required workshop identity). Visit-level print button flow could not be fully validated because visit print button was not rendered in tested UI states and one run showed vehicle page stuck on loading.

minor.issue: Existing preview auth regression remains: CORS credentials header missing on actual login response for production origin path in auth test suite.

integration_issues.issue: Could not complete required validation because visit print entry point was unavailable in rendered UI state.

action_items: Investigate why visit cards/visit print button are not consistently rendered on /vehicle/ffcf800c-d1bb-40df-8df3-effa59bc05cd (loading state / data gating).
After visit print button renders, retest visit quick-print action pack (print/download PDF/WhatsApp) end-to-end.

critical_code_review_comments: VehicleDetails.jsx remains very large (~4.5k lines) and state-heavy; this increases risk of conditional rendering regressions (e.g., visit print controls disappearing while header controls work).
Header print flow appears stable now; backend /api/documents/generate served invoice/diagnosis/quote successfully with no observed failures during UI test window.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Header quick print menu now validated as functional in sequence (invoice -> diagnosis -> quote) with required workshop fields and organized preview markers. Remaining blocker is visit-level print entry absence (no visit-print-button-* found) and intermittent vehicle loading state; retest should start by confirming visits render before attempting quick-print action buttons.
rca of the issue: Visit print validation blocker reproduces as: login -> open target vehicle page -> header data renders but no visit data-testid elements are present (or page remains in loading state). This prevents reaching quick-print actions under visit flow. Likely root cause is visit list conditional render / data fetch timing mismatch for this vehicle state, not document generator failure. Backend logs during the same window show successful document generation requests and no failed /api/documents/generate.
